company.name: SigTuple
company.shortDescription: SigTuple builds intelligent solutions for medical diagnosis using state of the art machine learning techniques.
company.description:
SigTuple's vision is to revolutionise the global medical diagnostic space through data driven intelligence. 

They aim to create a data driven, machine learned, cloud based solution for detection of anomalies and trends in medical data, which improves the accuracy and efficiency of disease diagnosis.

aiResearchSummary.text: SigTuple is engaged in developing a microfluidic cartridge for enriching biological fluids of low viscosity, featuring a base plate and coverslip to form a chamber for fluid processing. Additionally, they are working on a calibration slide for automated microscopes, which includes defined calibration zones divided by a cross hair to facilitate precise calibration. These efforts focus on enhancing medical diagnostic accuracy and automation.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: SigTuple combines AI100 with Shrava with AI100 with Shonit.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
